(ta)༄༅/ /lo thog sad srung mya ngan med pa'i kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba'i gsang gsum chu gter zab rgya che/ /thugs rje smon lam lhun

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// lo thog sad srung mya ngan med pa'i kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal ba'i gsang gsum chu gter zab rgya che// thugs rje smon lam lhun po'i bsrubs las skyes// rigs gsum sems dpa'i nyi zla nor bu yis// sems can re skong gsum la phyag bgyis nas// srid pa'i nyer 'tsho lo thog ba sad kyis// 'bru bcud nyams byed gdon bgegs zhi ba'i phyir// rigs gsum thugs rje nus pa'i gur khyim du// ye shes me drod sgrub pa'i cho ga 'dri// 'dir rigs gsum sems dpa' chen po'i sgo nas sad bsrung ba'i thabs la/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rigs gsum spyi'am khyad par gyi dbang thob cing*/ lha gsum gyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ 'khor lo bri dus ni/ gza' dar ba dang*/ sde brgyad theb pa/ klu theb pa/ yar tshes bzang po dang skar ma bzang po/ dus tshod bzang po la sman bzang drug dang*/ klu sman sna tshogs dang rin po che gser dngul lam snag tsha bsregs pas/ gnam sa bar snang gsum drod 'bebs kyi 'khor lo dkyus kyi bri thabs nas 'byung ba'am/ dpe ris dag pa gang rung ltar bris zin pa la/ nyer spyod bshams pa byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bdag bskyed rigs gsum sgrub thabs sngon du btang nas/ 'khor lo sbyang khrus byas la/ bris pa'i 'khor lo a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sprin gyi phung pos 'khor yug tu bskor ba'i dbus su lte ba mu khyud rim pa dang bcas pa rnams su yig 'bru'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i/ 'khor lo gsum ka'i yig 'bru'i gnas rnams su padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ 'khor lo dang po'i gdan rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyag na rdo rje dang*/ bar par hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa las spyan ras gzigs dang*/ 'og mar dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las 'jam dpal rnams rang rang gi sgrub thabs gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs gsal gdab/

thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang rang rang gi sa bon gsal gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas so sor gnyis su med par bstim pa de lta bu yang yang byas pas ye shes pa bstims la/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba thogs te lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dpal la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de dag la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri kū la nā tha sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar mtshan sngags re re sbyar bas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi sogs dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs dang*/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs kyis bstod/ mig thur ram rdo rjes spyan dbye ba'i tshul dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces lan gsum gyis spyan dbye/ slar yang mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas mthar/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpal gyi sku rnams 'od du zhu ba las dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi rang bzhin/

sa bon sngags phreng sogs bris pa'i 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yi ge bzhis yang yang bstim/ 'bru gtsang ma la ye dharmā mang du bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ci srid sa chu me rlung gi 'byung ba'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes dang me tog 'thor zhing*/ ye dharmā dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha brjod pa de lta bu lan gsum gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i shapda dharmā ra ṇi bcas pas mchod/ smra bsam brjod med sogs dang*/ dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu sogs nas/ zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis gang shes brjod la/ 'khor lo tshul bzhin du bltab ste/ tshon skud kyis dkris nas/ rang sgrub pa po gang du 'dug pa'i steng 'og bar gsum du gzhan gyis mi mthong bar stabs gang bder bzhag pa ni 'khor lo rab tu gnas par bya ba'o// yang sprin gta' dgram par bya ba'i sman ni/ thang lo/ smyug lo/ rma bya'i mdongs/ zi ra dkar nag dbang po lag pa/ chu srin sder mo/ rgya spos/ rgya mtsho sbu ba/ utpal sngon po/ rgya mtshal/ dung phor/ spos dkar/ snying zho sha mkhal ma zho sha mchin pa zho sha gla gor zho sha pu shel tse/ chu dag rdo rgyus bya bal ma/ nā ga utpal/ nā ga ge sar/ padma ge sar/ til dkar nag ga pur/ ka ra bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ kaṇḍa ka ri/ bal bu/ se shing*/

stag tsher/ seng tsher/ seng ldeng dkar dmar/ a ru ra/ ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra/ bla rkang*/ bzang drug tshang ma/ rin po che sna lnga/ 'bru sna tshogs/ de rnams zhib par btul la/ ba ra mdzo mo gsum gyi 'o mas sbrus la/ ril bu sha ba'i ril ma tsam grangs med par byas la/ de nas dpyid zla rwa ba'i tshes gcig gi rgyal gyi nyin par 'go btsugs la rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag re re bzlas la ril bu rnams dang 'khor lo rnams rab tu gnas par bya'o// de'ang khyi dang bud med 'khon 'thab yugs sa mo mdze mo sogs grib can la 'dzem par bya'o// 'khor lo bri ba'i nyin par nas yig 'brus gnam mi mthong ba dang*/ mi gzhan gyis yig 'bru mi mthong bar/ 'khor lo dang ril bu rnams mi lag mi brgyud par bya ba ni dam tshig yin pas shin tu bsrung ba gal che'o// zhes bshad pa ltar bya/ 'di ni nam dgos las sbyor dus su dgram rgyu yin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las sbyor la/ chu mig gnyan sa klu gnas nges pa'i sa'am dben pa'i gnas gang rung du song la/ der gzhi legs par bcas la/ rang gang bsrung ba'i yul gyi mchod phye bsdus la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma brgya rtsa btang ba'i yo byad dang*/ klu gtor gyi ril bu brgya rtsa dang*/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor sogs rin po che'i snod zangs dmar la sogs pa gtsang mar/ chu mig mang po'i chu sna srog chags med pa blangs nas dgang*/ shog bu la lha mo dkar mo zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sha ba'i gdan la gnas pa gos dkar po gsol ba/ phyag gnyis gser gyi bum pa shing lo'i kha rgyan can thogs pa/ de'i thugs kar rin po che bsres pa'i snag tshas e dang*/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ nā ga pu ri shog phu nā ga ku ru shog shog ghri ta nā ga le le baṃ baṃ swā hā zhes pa chu gta'i sngags sbrul 'khyil ba ltar mgo phyir bstan bris pa de smyug ma la btags te/ dar ram shing lo sna tshogs kyis g.yogs/ shug pa/

lcang ma/ 'om bu gsum la e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ āḥhūm̐ yi ge rnams dbu can du brtsegs mar bris la/ chu'i rgyan du bya'o// gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas pa zhig btang la/ de dag gi 'dod don gsol ba'i skabs su/ sa phyogs 'di nyid thog drang pa'i yul phyogs rnams kyi lo thog la grang sad kyis gnod pa mi 'byung ba bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes mgron tshan thams cad la gdags/ de'i mthar dkar cha bzhi nas 'byung ba'i cho gas klu gtor btang ba dang*/ yul de'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma rgya chen po phul zhing phrin las gong ltar bcol/ mthar bgegs gtor bran la/ cha gsum gyi mjug nas 'ong ba ltar bsngos la/ mthar gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song zhes pa'i rjes su/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag tu/ khyad par rang gi bsrung bya'i yul che ge zhes bya ba 'di'i 'khor yug kun gyi zhing gi lo thog la gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po mi ma yin 'gong po spun dgu la sogs pa'i sad 'dre gdug pa can thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig gal te mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ phyogs kun tu yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ gu gul gyis bdug la/ oṃ sarba bighnā na gatstsha/ na maḥs manta kā ya sogs nas/ anta ka ra ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis bgegs bskrad la/ mgron rigs rnams gshegs su gsol ba sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// de nas yi ge rnying par klu'i pho brang gi dkyil sogs nas smyug ma drang pa la 'khor lo bskor bar bshad kyang*/ stabs mi bde shing dgos don cher ma bgyis pas/ sgrub pa po'i bsti gnas nye phyogs kyi 'khor lo steng ma bla nas kha sbub kyi tshul dang*/

bar pa gyen bstan gyi tshul dang*/ 'og ma sa gzhir kha sbub kyi tshul du 'byung bar byas na chog par sems so// de nas bsham pa'i mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bha wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ nas shabda swā hā'i bar dang*/ dharma ra ṇi dril bu sogs rol mo bcas bya'o// rigs gsum sgrub thabs rang gang mos sam tshigs bcad du bsdebs par spro na/ 'di ltar bya ste/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can deng nas bzung*// byang chub bar du rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gang rung dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag cag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon// bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor nyams su blang bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba rgyur bcas ldan// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas pa bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde la rtag gnas shing*// nye ring chags sdang med par gnas gyur cig /zhes tshad med bzhi bsgom/ ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur zhes so// dngos gzhi la/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge paṃ gsum las// padma'i gnas gsum a las zla gdan steng*// rang sems ngo bo dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ gsum las// 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus 'bru gsum yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid rigs gsum mgon por gyur pa ni// dbus su 'jam dpal btso ma gser gyi mdog

/phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri mkhar 'phyar zhing*// g.yon pas utpal sdong bu thugs kar bzung*// 'dab stong snyan thad gyes steng po ti bsnams// lang tsho bcu drug lor gnas 'dzum sgeg nyams// ral pa'i cod paṇa zur phud lnga dang ldan// mi phyed zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dbang ston zla'i mdangs// phyag bzhi'i dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar// 'og ma gnyis kyis phreng ba padma 'dzin// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// g.yon du phyag na rdo rje'i sku mdog sngo// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar dang*// g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten 'gying bag nyams// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// gsum ga'ang mtshan dang dpe byad lham mer gsal// sna tshogs dar gyi stod g.yogs smad sham bklubs// rin chen rgyan phreng brgyad kyis sku la brgyan// snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can gyur// de nas thal mo gnyis sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa mgo bo reg cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga todbha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo sbyar ba padma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas pas snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ padmodbha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo gnyis rgyab sbyar la mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar nas lte bar reg cing*/ oṃ badzrodbha wā ya swā hā/ zhes rigs gsum gyi dam tshig gi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// lha de gsum gyi spyi bor rnam snang dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas mi bskyod pa yis brgyan// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// rang bzhin lhun grub gnas nas rigs gsum mgon// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas yongs bskor ba// skad cig spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zlar brtan par bzhugs// bkra shis padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ// mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas// mchod yul dgyes pa'i nyer spyod gya nom pa// mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo mchod pa'i sprin chen 'di// rgyal ba kun dngos rigs gsum lha tshogs la// 'bul gyis bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai we dyaṃ/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// bsam mi khyab bdag mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// 'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /'gro ba'i re skong rigs gsum mgon la bstod// sku gsung thugs 'jam 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin yon tan rgyas pa'i sku// de phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur mtshan gsol ba// blo gros bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// rig sngags gsang sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag mdun lha gsum gsal ba'i thugs ka'i zlar// dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ gi sa bon gsum gyi mthar// rang rang sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal// mdun bskyed thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las// 'od zer sngags phreng rnam pa phyogs bcur 'phros// rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan rang grub pa dang*// lha klu drang srong kun gyi mkhyen brtse mthu// ji snyed tshur bsdus rang gi thugs kar thim// de dag kun gyi byin rlabs nus pa yi// dngos grub thams cad rgyud la zhugs par bsam// oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ gtso bor bzla/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ zhes pa gnyis kyang ci nus bzlas mthar/ mchod yon me tog sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha bar dang*/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs sogs shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/

dkar gtor chab kyis bran te/ rdo rje bsnams pa 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a dya nutpanna twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha gsum gyi ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa sogs sngags gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod pa gong bzhin rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog zhes pas gsol btab lha gsum 'od du zhu/ 'khor lo gsum la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes bsam pa ni bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha gsal gdab pa ni/ nam mkha' byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams las phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa chad de/ nam mkha' mthing ga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa dang dbyer med du gyur pa las nam mkha' phyag na rdo rje g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten nas nam mkha' zil gyis gnon pa'i sku de lta bus nam mkha'i khams khyab par bsams la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ lcang lo can sogs kyis bstod la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyis yul phyogs 'di'i lo thog la sad kyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing nam mkha'i khams thams cad drod kyis khyab par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ zhes pa sngags mang tsam bgrangs/ e la ba yi sogs kyi sham bu btags pa'ang mang du bzlas/ slar yang nam mkha' byin rlabs kyi 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge dkar po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las shākya thub pa mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar zhing g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsum gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa de las sku de 'dra grangs med pas ni nam mkha' thams cad gang nas chos kyi sgra chen po rab tu sgrogs nas nam mkha' la gnas pa'i 'byung po sad 'dre gdug pa can thams cad gnod sems kyi gdug pa dang bral nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā mu ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pas yul phyogs 'di'i lo thog la sad kyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing nam mkha'i khams thams cad drod kyis khyab par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol la/ rtsa bsnyen mu ni can mang du bgrangs pa'i mthar/ e la ba yi naṃ hur hriṃ maṃ swā hā sprin sdus shig ces sham bu btags pa'ang ci nus bzla/ de ni nam mkha' byin gyis brlabs pa'o// gnyis pa bar snang sprin sdud 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa de las de 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa chad de gnam sa bar snang thams cad thugs rje chen pos khengs par bsgoms la/ de rnams kyi sku'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas sa 'og klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la phog klu rnams kyis ma bzod nas srog snying phul zhing phyag na sprin gyi rgyal mtshan re re bsnams pas bar snang gi khams su sprin dang na bun gyi phung po chen pos rab tu gtibs par bsams la/

oṃ ārya a wa lo ki te sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas yul phyogs 'di'i lo thog la sad kyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing bar snang thams cad sprin gyis khyab par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol la/ bar snang sprin sdud kyi sngags ma ṇi can mang du bgrangs pa'i mthar/ e hur thuṃ ril sprin sdus pra ti baṃ swā hā ces sham bu btags pa ci nus bzla/ de ni bar snang sprin sdud kyi man ngag go /gsum pa sa gzhi drod 'bebs kyi 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥlas 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon utpal dmar ser gyi steng du brgyad stong pa'i po ti 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sku'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo dang padma'i yu ba nas me 'bar ba'i klong nas khro bo ser nag stong sprul pa'i khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis sgra sgrog cing*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pas steng 'og gi sad 'dre gdug pa can thams cad bzlog par bsam/ snang srid sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad 'jam dpal gyi skus tham 'gag tu bsgom zhing*/ de rnams las ye shes kyi me 'u ru ru 'bar bar bsam/ lo thog la gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po mi ma yin pa thams cad bsregs/ sa gzhi dang rgya mtsho chen po dros nas rlangs pa phyur nas sprin du 'khrigs par bsams la/ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs kyis bstod/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'khor dang bcas pas yul phyogs 'di'i lo thog la sad kyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing sa gzhi thams cad drod kyis khyab par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol la/ sa gzhi drod 'bebs kyi sngags wā gī shwa ri can mang du bgrangs mthar/ oṃ hi phu khaṃ pra ti sa ri swā hā dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza a ti u le li ti swā hā ces sham bu btags pa mang du bzla/ de'ang nam stod nam mkha' byin rlabs/ nam phyed bar snang sprin sdud/ nam smad sa gzhi drod 'bebs bya/ de'i sad chen po khog par the tshom med do// de dag gi bar skabs rnams su spro na/ sngar gyi chu gta' dang lha mo'i sku bris pa la dmigs te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du rgya mtsho chen po chu'i spris ma chen po dpag tshad chags pa'i steng du/ mtsho'i sbu ba sprin phung gur tsam zhig gi dbus su/ srid pa chags byed kyi lha mo dkar mo na bza' gsol ba/ phyag gnyis gser gyi bum pa shing lo'i kha rgyan nor bu'i dbyibs can bsnams pa/ zhabs brkyangs bskums sha ba yu mo'i khri la bzhugs pa/ 'khor 'byung ba lnga'i lha mo klu gnyan sa bdag 'bum gyis bskor ba/ de dag rnams kyi bum pa shing lo sprin phung bsnams pa thugs kar yi ge es mtshan par bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum gyi gnas nas srid pa chags byed kyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa ā karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim par bsams la/ nā ga phu ri shog phu nā ga ku ru shog shog ghri ta nā ga le le baṃ baṃ swā hā zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla zhing*/ bdag rigs gsum mgon po'i thugs ka nas yi ge gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'phros pas srid pa'i bdag mo'i e la phog pas nam mkha' sprin dang zhag gis thibs se khyab par bsam par bya'o// 'og sa gzhir drod kyis 'geb pa/ bar du sprin phung dkar po dung lta bus srid gsum thams cad khyab par gyur nas/ srid gsum bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par bsam zhes yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar byas kyang legs/ khyad par sad bla bu yug dang*/ byang rlung kha ba dang*/

sprin yang shar dang lho ru 'gro ba dang*/ dgongs spud dang*/ 'brug skad hur la thung ba dang*/ ser ba dang bcas pa dang*/ de rnams ni nyul ma dang 'dra bas sad kyi sna khrid do// ltas de gang byung yang skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsgom bzlas la 'bad par bya ba dang*/ khyad par tho rangs kyi sprin med pa'i nam mkha' shin tu thangs par gyur na/ grogs gzhan la sogs pas shugs pa sogs lha shing rigs kyi bsang dud chen po btang du bcug pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang 'khor lo gsum po'i dmigs pa ma gsal ba dang*/ sngags 'bru chad pa dang*/ gnyid yur byed pa dang*/ le lo dang thang lhod shor na don mi 'grub pas shin tu mkhas shing brtson 'grus dang ldan par bya'o// de ltar man ngag brtson 'grus dang ldan par byas na/ bang mdzod btsan por 'bru tshud pa dang 'dra bas/ 'bru rin po che la sad gtong bar byed pa'i byung po gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed cing sad kyi 'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro// des na 'di ni sad bsrung ba'i man ngag kho na'o// de'ang nam mkha' byin rlabs kyi 'khor los gnod byed rnams kyis mi tshugs/ bar snang sprin sdud kyi 'khor los bar snang sprin dang na bun 'khrigs/ sa gzhi drod 'bebs kyi 'khor los sa la drod 'byung zhing ba mo mi chags/ gal te chags kyang 'bru mi sad/ 'khor lo ni yig rnying las 'byung ba nam mkha' byin rlabs kyi 'khor lo ni/ gro ga'am shog bu la mu khyud rim pa gsum bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gi mthar yig mgo phyir bstan la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ sprin sdus sdus swā hā/ ces bri/ de'i phyi rol rtsibs brgyad bris pa'i rtsibs rnams su/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ nā ga phu ri shog phu nā ga ku ru shog shog ghri ta nā ga le le baṃ baṃ sprin sdus shig swā hā zhes pa sngags mgo phyir bstan sbrul 'khyil lta bur rtsibs re re la tshang bar dgod/

de'i phyi rim mu khyud la/ oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro dha hya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ e hur thuṃ ril sprin sdus pra ti baṃ swā hā/ tshar gnyis gsum gang tshud bri/ ces yig mgo thams cad phyir bstan no// de'i phyi rol du sprin ris ci mdzes su bri'o// gnyis pa bar snang sprin sdud kyi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa gsum bskor ba'i yig mgo thams cad nang du bstan la/ lte bar hrīḥyig gi mthar oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ e la ba ya naṃ hur hriṃ maṃ swā hā/ sprin sdus shig ces bri/ de'i phyi rim mu khyud la/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ i le la hur thuṃ hril sprin sdus pra ti pra ti bha ri swā hā zhes pa'ang tshar gnyis gsum gang tshud bri'o// de'i phyi rim mu khyud la/ ye dharmā dang sprin sdus shig swā hā/ de'i phyi rol du sprin ris bri'o// gsum pa sa gzhi drod 'bebs kyi 'khor lo bri ba la/ mu khyud rim pa gsum bskor ba'i lte bar dhīḥdang*/ oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ/ hrī phu khaṃ/ pra ti pra ti swā hā ces bri/ de'i phyi rim padma 'dab brgyad la/ oṃ ya manta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e la hur thuṃ hrī ril dza sprin sdus pra ti pra ti bi ri swā hā/ ces rtsibs re re la sbrul 'khyil du tshang bar bri/ de'i phyi rim la ye dharmā dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza a ti u le li ti swā hā bri/ yig mgo thams cad phyir la bstan no// de'i phyi rim du sprin ris bri'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ nyin mo thun 'jog pa na/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā mu ni tri kū la nā tha sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs re re'i 'gor sbyar ba shabda rol mo dharma ra ṇi bcas pas mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs dang*/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs dang*/ skyon gyi ma gos sogs dang*/

lcang lo can sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha skong*/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa dang phyag na rdo rje nam mkha' byin rlabs 'khor lo la thim/ spyan ras gzigs rnams bar snang sprin sdud kyi 'khor lo la/ 'jam dpal rnams sa gzhi drod 'bebs kyi 'khor lo la thim/ 'khor lo'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ me tog thogs shing su pra tiṣṭha dang ye dharmā brjod cing brtan bzhugs byas la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis rgyas par brjod pas mtha' brgyan pa dang*/ bdag dang gzhan gyi dus gsum sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes bya'o// smras pa/ lo thog 'bras bu sad las bsrung ba'i thabs// sngags spyod las la som nyi mi bya ste// ston pa rigs gsum thugs rjes rgyud bskul ba'i// byin rlabs bden pas bslus pa cang srid dam// 'on te yi ge rnying par gab 'khrugs dang*// mi gsal mun par 'thums pa'i mya ngan med// 'gal 'brel dpyad pa'i yid 'phrog rkang pa'i rtses// bsnun tsam 'dab stong grol ba'i ltad mo byung*// 'di sbyar dge bas byang chub snying po'i bar// tshe rabs bslab gsum ldan pa'i gtan thob nas// lus can srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las// gdon pa'i byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin shog /lo thog sad srung mya ngan med pa'i kha 'byed zhes bya ba 'di ni smad shod chos rje tshul khrims bzang po'i ngor/ yi ge rnying pa'i brjod byed ma dag pa dang dgab 'khrugs dang mi gsal ba rnams dpyad pa gsum gyi zhu bcos kyis nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul rin gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/

༈ //dpal ldan bla ma rigs gsum mgon// tha dad med la phyag 'tshal nas// gang dag dgos pa'i skabs rnams su// rlung gnon bya ba'i lag len bstan// de'ang 'dir rigs gsum mgon gyi sgo nas rlung mnan bya ba la/ sātstsha gsum la tshon dmar ser dkar sngo gsum gsol ba'i nang du srog shing cung zad dang bcas pa la rigs gsum rang rang gi gzungs ci mang bris pa yig 'go nang bstan du dril ba bcug la/ sbyong khrus byas la/ thog mar oṃ las rnam snang du bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten gyi tshogs su gyur pa'i bum pa rnams kyi nang du dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ las ral gri padma rdo rje rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa las/ rigs gsum mgon 'khor lo'i rab gnas kyi skabs ltar bskyed la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rigs gsum gyi rnam par yang yang bstim/ rgyas gdab spyan dbye mchod bstod brtan bzhugs/ slar yang mchod bstod byas la/ mchod rten gyi bstod pa bkra shis rnams gong 'khor lo'i skabs ltar byas/ de nas shog bu rlung lha ljang gu sha ba yu mo nyal thabs su gnas pa la zhon pa ba dan gyi dar lce yu ba la dkris pa zung ba de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ bā yu bā yu naṃ staṃ bha ya naṃ hūm̐ laṃ gyis bskor ba yig 'go phyir bstan pa bris la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug lan bdun tsam yid ches par byas la/ oṃ bā yu bā yu naṃ staṃ bha ya naṃ hūm̐ laṃ zhes pa ci nus dang rlung mnan gzhan gyi sngags gang shes kyang bzla'o// nub byang mtshams su dong brus pa'i nang du gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng du g.yam pa'am kham phor nang du laṃ dang steng du rgya gram bris pa de'i steng nas rigs gsum gyi sātstshas mnan la/

rigs gsum mgon por mchod bstod dang las ma grub bar du rlung gnon pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// mthar las grub pa na sātstsha sogs yar blangs la/ rlung lha la mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la bum pa'i chus khrus byas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ wa ya we sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā dang*/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i sogs dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams sogs dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas rlung lha 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs la/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba bsngo'o// zhes rlung gnon gyi ngag 'don gsal sgron 'di'ang sad srung gi yan lag tu tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
